'''Mangaluru''' (also called Mangalore) is a port city on the west coast of India, in the state of [[Karnataka]]. It sits between the Arabian Sea and the Western Ghats, where the Netravati and Gurupura rivers meet the sea.

== Languages ==
Mangaluru is known for having many languages in everyday use. People speak [[Tulu]], [[Kannada]], [[Konkani]] and [[Beary]], and many are comfortable in several of them. Tulu and Kannada both have their own Wikipedias.

== Education ==
The city is a major education centre. St Aloysius, founded in 1880, is one of its oldest colleges.

== Food ==
Mangaluru food is famous for seafood, coconut and fiery spice. Neer dosa, fish curry and Mangalore buns are well-known local dishes.
